description: Return the signed-in account's watchlists: id, name, bond count, the owner's page and the public link when shared. Use the id with bondterminal_save_watchlist to add bonds to a watchlist. Returns no bond data; at most 100 watchlists per account. Billing: free; consumes no calculation or read units.
name: bondterminal_list_watchlists

publicUrl.description: Read-only public link, when the watchlist is shared.

url.description: The owner's page; it needs the owner's sign-in.

title: My watchlists
